methods.label: Add, then take the reciprocal
methods.explanation:
First add the fractions using a common denominator:
\[
\frac12+\frac23=\frac36+\frac46=\frac76.
\]
The sum is nonzero. Its reciprocal is the number that multiplies it to give \(1\), so interchange numerator and denominator to obtain \(\boxed{\frac67}\), choice \(\text{A}\).
